//: Farmify builds to a plain folder of static files, so it is deployed as a
static site rather than through the Next.js runtime. `framework: null` is
the load-bearing part: without it Vercel detects Next.js, takes over output
resolution, and ignoring or fighting `outputDirectory` leaves it serving
nothing, which surfaces as a 404 on every route. Settings here override the
project's dashboard settings, so the deploy does not depend on how the
project happened to be configured when it was first imported.
